reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

posts.text:
A country without borders isn’t a country at all.

We secured ours: 18 straight months of zero releases at the border.

Democrats will spend the next two years trying to undo it. We won’t let them. https://t.co/fZb5JhUUif
https://t.co/YVnHyyCkCY

I joined local leaders in Armada Township to announce $2.25 million in funding to upgrade the township’s fire station.

Armada’s first responders deserve the resources they need to keep our families safe. I’m proud to help bring this investment back to our community to support the men and women who answer the call when we need them most.

I’m deeply saddened by the loss of former State Representative John Reilly.

John lived with quiet strength, guided by his faith and a genuine desire to help others. Those who knew him will remember his kindness and steady commitment to his community.

My thoughts and prayers are with the Reilly family during this difficult time.

Freedom isn’t free. It’s been earned and defended by generations of brave American heroes who put our country before themselves.

On Veterans Day, we honor their service, their sacrifice, and their unwavering love for this great nation.

God bless our veterans, and God bless America! 🇺🇸

This Veterans Day, I’m thinking of the men and women across Michigan and our country who answered the call to serve.

It’s an honor to represent you and advocate for you every day in Washington. https://t.co/uOdViulQo6

I am honored to continue serving as House GOP Chair in the 120th Congress.

The House GOP is ready to move forward under Leader Jordan and Whip Emmer’s leadership.

We have work to do to regain Americans’ trust. That work starts right now. https://t.co/nezE37RLwb
